item.title: NANCY: DOSSIER OF DISASTER
item.description: THE final whistle that signalled the end of a depressing derby day defeat on Saturday also brought down the final curtain on Wilfried Nancy’s remarkable 33-day career as Celtic manager. item.title: ‘A WEE BIT STRANGE,’ ADMITS COMEBACK BHOY O’NEILL
item.description: MARTIN O’NEILL has been named Celtic manager until the end of the season – only hours after Wilfried Nancy had been sacked. item.description: WE CAN all be grateful Martin O’Neill hadn’t booked a world cruise this winter. item.description: JULIAN ARAUJO will go down in history as flop boss Wilfried Nancy’s only signing for Celtic.
